description: An expander for Bascom, placed immediately to its right, which opens up the filter's internal structure so that a mode and a colouring can be designed

params.text: Sets how many times the sample rate the filter runs at, 1 to 12; higher rates keep the distortion from aliasing
Sets how many filter stages are used when resampling back down, 1 to 12
Sets how many samples pass between one parameter update and the next, 1 to 128
Sets how much of the signal entering the ladder is added into the output mix; the ends of its travel do nothing, because Bascom clamps the value to a narrower range
Sets how much of the first pole's output is added into the output mix; the ends of its travel do nothing, because Bascom clamps the value to a narrower range
Sets how much of the second pole's output is added into the output mix; the ends of its travel do nothing, because Bascom clamps the value to a narrower range
Sets how much of the third pole's output is added into the output mix; the ends of its travel do nothing, because Bascom clamps the value to a narrower range
Selects the distortion curve applied to the signal arriving at the filter
Selects the distortion curve applied to the signal entering the first pole
Selects the distortion curve applied to the signal entering the second pole
Selects the distortion curve applied to the signal entering the third pole
Selects the distortion curve applied to the signal entering the fourth pole
Sets how much of the fourth pole's output is added into the output mix; the ends of its travel do nothing, because Bascom clamps the value to a narrower range
Shifts the cutoff of the first pole, -24 to +24 semitones from the filter frequency
Shifts the cutoff of the second pole, -24 to +24 semitones from the filter frequency
Shifts the cutoff of the third pole, -24 to +24 semitones from the filter frequency
Shifts the cutoff of the fourth pole, -24 to +24 semitones from the filter frequency
Crossfades the resonance feedback between the summed pole outputs and the filter's own mixed output
Selects the distortion curve applied to the resonance feedback

notes: the knobs do nothing unless a Bascom is the module immediately to the left; they then write straight into it, and loading a preset there reads the values back into them
the expander has module presets of its own for each mode, listed under Factory presets in the Preset submenu of the panel menu
